prompt.text: At night on the rain-lashed deck of a fictional container ship, a single rescue worker wears a matte yellow storm suit with black reinforced knees, a plain white helmet, and a black safety line clipped to the waist. A rigid red emergency case with two silver latches breaks loose on the wet deck and slides screen-right toward a low railing. In one continuous five-second shot, hold a low medium-wide witness position beside a fixed row of blue cargo containers as the ship rolls. The worker lunges after the case, drops onto the right knee, and reaches with the left hand. End before the rescue resolves: the left fingertips have just caught the case's black strap, both worker and case are still sliding screen-right, and the safety line is taut toward an upper-left deck anchor. Cold blue work lights remain fixed overhead; one distant lightning flash briefly exposes rain and steel without changing the source geography. Preserve the container row, railing, screen direction, case shape, latch count, suit colors, and causal weight. Water sheets downhill with the ship's roll; no cuts, no impossible crane move, no explosion, no injury detail, no text, no real company markings.
